description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Diggala, Panadura D/S Division, Kalutara District - (24/1198)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and property ownership matters. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including ownership details, parcel numbers, extents, and encumbrances. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes), and is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
